note.description: Why the workflow is shaped this way, where that is not obvious from its steps: a step it deliberately does not have, say.

explicit.description: true: only a request by id reaches this workflow (`noetic-harness route --workflow`, `noetic-harness run --start`), and the router must never choose it by score. WF-021 needs it because a trigger with no kinds and no keywords is not enough: its steps carry the commonest capabilities in the registry, and with T2 and a three-gate lane it holds less authority than any workflow but WF-004, so it won every capability-only tie on the router's least-authority tie-break. Only as good as `Noetic.Harness.Router` honouring it.

lane_paths.description: Which paths `run --finish` runs the lane over, when that is not everything changed since the run's own base. Absent, `Run.lane_paths/2` behaves as it always has, and explicit `--paths` still win. WF-021 declares it so that a worker's lane runs over the path set merge-check reads: `git diff merge-base(<ref>, HEAD)..HEAD`, minus the prefixes in `exclude`, which are the files the run and the handoff write by the very act of finishing. `committed_only` also makes `--finish` refuse a tree with uncommitted changes outside `exclude`, because the verdict is recorded against a head and a head does not contain them.

since.description: The only rule there is: the merge-base of `ref` and HEAD. A two-dot diff against `ref` itself would count every commit that landed on develop after the branch left it as the branch's own change.

ref.description: A ref git can resolve, such as `origin/develop`. Never an option: it cannot begin with `-`, and git receives it after `--end-of-options`.

exclude.description: Path prefixes left out of the lane's paths and out of the dirty-tree refusal, matched as string prefixes, so a directory ends in `/`.

committed_only.description: true: the lane's paths are committed changes only, and `--finish` refuses uncommitted or untracked files outside `exclude`.

independent_of.description: Step ids whose performing agent may not also perform this step. This is how the review fabric stops an agent evaluating its own work.

on.description: A typed reason the conductor can look up. `when` is prose for a human; matching on it would make the meaning depend on the wording, and 'the budget cannot be met' can name a performance budget as easily as a retry budget.
